# UrbanPro

> UrbanPro is India's leading online and offline tutoring marketplace connecting students with expert tutors across academics, languages, and hobbies.

UrbanPro operates as a comprehensive education platform serving major Indian cities including Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Chennai. The platform facilitates both personalized tuition and group classes across K-12 education, higher studies, language learning, and skill development.
